canonical.title: Osaka Weekend: 3-Star Michelin Dinner + Two Days

sources.claim: All three 3-star restaurants need 3–6 months' lead time for a Saturday seat; Hajime ¥35,900+, jacket + leather shoes required
Taian omakase dinner ¥33,500 incl. ¥8,000 fee; 16 counter seats; open charcoal grill; closed Mondays
Hajime and Taian accessible via OMAKASE JapanEatinerary for foreign tourists; 13 Michelin 3-star restaurants in Japan
Taian guests choose from 5 main-course options; photography permitted; Chef Takahata spent 15 years at Ajikitcho
Hajime earned three Michelin stars 17 months after opening in 2008 — fastest ascent in Japanese culinary history
Hajime Chikyu dish: ~110 ingredients on a single landscape plate representing the cycle of life
Kashiwaya minimum 2 guests; dinner ¥28,500–¥83,500 incl. ¥8,000 fee; min. age 12
Kashiwaya: 7 private sukiya-zukuri dining houses in a garden; interior by master craftsman Toshiyuki Nakamura
Osaka Castle keep open daily 9:00–17:00, last entry 16:30
Toyotomi Stone Wall Museum opened April 2025 next to castle tower; exposes 16th-c. Hideyoshi-era walls; adds 30–40 min
Osaka 2026 rainy season forecast to start June 6
More than half of June days see rain in Osaka at 20–27°C
Tenjinbashi-suji covered arcade is Japan's longest at 2.6 km — tsuyu safety net
Umeda Sky Building Floating Garden observatory open until 22:30, last entry 22:00; ¥1,300
Full Kyoto loop (Fushimi Inari + Kiyomizu-dera + Arashiyama + Gion) takes ~9 hours
Kobe is 20 min from Osaka by JR Special Rapid; ¥420
Nara is 30 min from Osaka; ¥510
Koyasan is 2 hours each way from Osaka — kills Saturday dinner window entirely
Kuromon Ichiba: arrive at 8 am to beat cruise-ship surge; ~10–15% of stalls closed Sunday
Shinsekai kushikatsu from 16:00 when neon turns on; no-double-dipping rule
teamLab Botanical Garden at Nagai runs June 1–July 31 from 19:45; ¥1,800+; tickets online only
Taian official website — 1-21-2 Shimanochi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; near Nagahoribashi Station
2026 Michelin Guide confirms Osaka's three 3-star restaurants: Hajime, Kashiwaya Senriyama, Taian
Hozenji Yokocho: 60+ traditional restaurants on a lantern-lit stone alley 3 min from Namba
Kashiwaya Senriyama bookable via Rakuten Travel Experiences with English support
Osaka Castle admission doubled to ¥1,200 when Toyotomi Stone Wall Museum opened April 2025
